**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744)
Thanks for the [cheque](../others.html#160). I think it is a very good thing to cheapen [Womankind](../books.html#115), especially as it is getting a start through the [Mothers’ Union](../others.html#31) taking it up.

It will also be well to have [New Ground](../books.html#68) at 2s [Mr Scarth](../persons.html#1272) of the Waterside Mission is very anxious to have Friday’s Child published separately for the sake of the sailors. I believe [Miss Crompton](../persons.html#390)[^2] has been urged to write to you about it and I hope you will do it.

She is singularly unambitious

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^2]: Frances Crompton, author of Friday\'s Child, was one of Innes\'s authors.
